items.title: Pay chimney renovation invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Betrag binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026 (Thursday). This is a private company invoice, not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the stated period runs 'ab dem Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date itself). Per §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event (19.11.) is not counted, so counting starts 20.11.2026. 14 days later lands on 03.12.2026 (Thursday). That day is a normal business day in NW (no weekend/holiday clash), so per §188(1)/§193 BGB no shift is needed. Final due date: 03.12.2026.

warnings: The invoice's IBAN (DE10 3705 0198 0005 5724 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to this company; before paying, compare it against earlier invoices or the firm's official contact details, and note that the sender's own phone number and email (not independently verified) are the only contact details given.
